messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Media in Finland during the 1960s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Finland historical newspaper digitized 1960s National Library dataset
Finland 1960s television radio broadcasting archives dataset Yle
Finnish mass media statistics 1960 newspapers circulation historical dataset
action.query: Finland historical newspaper digitized 1960s National Library dataset

queries: site:stat.fi mass media statistics database 1960 Finland newspapers magazines
site:finna.fi 1960 television radio recordings Finland archive
action.query: site:stat.fi mass media statistics database 1960 Finland newspapers magazines

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Yleisradio (YLE) – Radio and Television Audience Research and Statistics, 1960","url_or_doi":"https://finna.fi/Record/elka.143410010946600_157001708415800","justification":"Highly relevant archival dataset from Finland's national broadcaster, Yleisradio. Contains radio and television audience research reports, programme research, and broadcasting licence statistics from 1960. Particularly useful for studying media consumption, television adoption, radio listenership, and broadcasting audiences in Finland. Partially digitized; additional access may require contacting the archive."},{"title":"Statistics Finland – Historical Mass Media Statistics","url_or_doi":"https://stat.fi/en/documentation/documentation-of-statistics/jvie","justification":"Official Finnish statistical collection covering newspapers, magazines, radio, television, media consumption, and the media industry. Although comprehensive media market statistics begin in 1997, some historical series extend back to 1938, including magazine and periodical counts. Useful for examining developments in Finnish mass media during the 1960s. The statistical series was discontinued in 2024, but historical data remain available."},{"title":"Statistics Finland – Statistical Yearbook of Finland","url_or_doi":"https://stat.fi/en/services/library-and-archiving-services/library-and-publications/statistical-yearbook-of-finland","justification":"Official historical statistical yearbooks covering Finnish society and economic activities, including culture and communications. Historical editions from the 1960s can provide quantitative information about newspaper publishing, broadcasting, radio and television licences, and related media infrastructure. Particularly useful for constructing historical time series and examining changes throughout the decade."},{"title":"YLE Living Archive (Elävä arkisto) – Historical Finnish Radio and Television Broadcasts","url_or_doi":"https://vintti.yle.fi/yle.fi/elavaarkisto/indexc991.html?n=archive&s=t","justification":"Historical audiovisual archive maintained by Finland's national public broadcaster. Contains television broadcasts, radio programmes, news footage, and historical recordings dating from 1906 onward, including material from the 1960s. Useful for qualitative research on Finnish television, radio journalism, political communication, popular culture, and media representations. Primarily an archival collection rather than a downloadable structured dataset."},{"title":"YLE – Open Cultural Heritage and Broadcasting Data","url_or_doi":"https://yle.fi/a/20-172134","justification":"Official YLE open-data catalogue providing access to historical broadcasting materials, audiovisual recordings, and photographs. Particularly relevant are photographs documenting YLE's institutional and technological development between the 1930s and 1960s. Also includes historical sound materials beginning in 1957. Useful for studying broadcasting technology, media institutions, and the development of Finnish public broadcasting."},{"title":"National Library of Finland – Digitised Newspaper and Periodical Collections","url_or_doi":"https://kansalliskirjasto.finna.fi/Content/digi?lng=en-gb","justification":"National repository of Finnish newspapers and periodicals, providing historical publication metadata and digitized newspaper content. Relevant for investigating newspaper coverage, editorial practices, political communication, and print media. However, complete newspaper digitization currently reaches 1959, with extension into the 1960s planned. Later material may be available through restricted institutional access or physical collections."},{"title":"National Library of Finland – Newspaper and Periodical Corpus (KLK)","url_or_doi":"https://www.kielipankki.fi/corpora/klk/","justification":"Research-oriented corpus containing historical Finnish and Swedish-language newspapers and magazines. Provides digitized textual material suitable for computational linguistic analysis, historical discourse research, and media studies. The collection begins in 1770, but individual corpus versions have different chronological coverage; researchers must verify whether a particular version includes 1960s publications. Particularly useful for text-mining methodologies."},{"title":"National Library of Finland – Digitized Newspaper Metadata (OAI-PMH)","url_or_doi":"https://www.kiwi.fi/spaces/Datacatalog/pages/86972052/Digi%2BOAI-PMH","justification":"Machine-readable metadata service for digitized Finnish newspapers and journals. Supports systematic collection of bibliographic metadata, publication titles, and information about digitized holdings. Useful for reconstructing historical newspaper collections and identifying relevant publications. The documented public newspaper sets primarily cover material before 1919, so direct coverage of the 1960s is limited."},{"title":"Yleisradio – Historical Radio and Television Archival Records, 1944–1972","url_or_doi":"https://finna.fi/Record/elka.143410010946600_157252044442900?page=13","justification":"Archival catalogue containing records from Yleisradio, Finland's public broadcaster, including materials covering the 1960s. Relevant holdings include broadcasting administration, programme documentation, correspondence, press clippings, and institutional records. Useful for researching the development of Finnish radio and television, broadcasting policies, and the relationship between broadcasters and the press. Access conditions vary by archival item."},{"title":"Yleisradio – Television Documentation, February–March 1960","url_or_doi":"https://www.finna.fi/Record/elka.143410010946600_143410032991200","justification":"Specific archival collection from Yleisradio documenting television-related activities between February 16 and March 31, 1960. Provides primary-source material for examining Finnish television operations at the beginning of the decade. Particularly useful for institutional and historical media research. The collection is access-restricted and may require an archival request."},{"title":"Statistics Finland – Historical Finnish Mass Media Statistical Publications","url_or_doi":"https://stat.fi/meta/til/jvie_en.html","justification":"Official statistical resource describing Finland's mass media sector, including newspapers, magazines, television, radio, publishing, and media consumption. Provides access to historical statistical publications and time-series information. Some underlying historical indicators cover the 1960s, although most modern datasets begin considerably later. Useful for identifying relevant statistical series and their original sources."},{"title":"Statistics Finland – Historical Archives","url_or_doi":"https://stat.fi/en/services/library-and-archiving-services/statistics-finlands-archive","justification":"Official archival resource providing access information for historical Finnish statistical materials. Potentially useful for locating original media-related statistics, including publishing, broadcasting, communications, and household media ownership during the 1960s. This is a broader archive rather than a dedicated media dataset; identifying relevant records may require assistance from Statistics Finland."},{"title":"National Library of Finland – Digital Collections Data Source","url_or_doi":"https://datahub.aalto.fi/en/data-sources/national-library-of-finland-digital-collections","justification":"Research data catalogue describing the National Library of Finland's digitized historical newspaper collections. Provides information about available newspaper datasets, research access arrangements, and digital humanities applications. Useful for identifying historical Finnish print-media sources and institutional access options. Coverage varies by collection, and access to copyrighted material from the 1960s may be restricted."}]}
